claims.claim: Saka scored the only goal, in the 59th minute, in Arsenal's 1-0 win at Aston Villa on 31 August 2026
claims.note: Both sources: Monday 31 Aug 2026, 1-0, Saka 59th minute, only goal.

claims.claim: Goal build-up: Eze pass to Calafiori, low cross poked in by Saka
claims.note: Al Jazeera: Eze pass found Calafiori, whose low cross Saka poked in. AP: bundled home after Eze/Calafiori interplay.

claims.claim: Buendia hit the crossbar; Pau Torres blocked Tzolis tap-in; Tzolis replaced by Eze at half-time
claims.note: Each detail confirmed on the page.

claims.claim: Same starting XI as the 3-0 win over Coventry ten days earlier; 250th league game for Arteta; six points, joint top
Declan Rice limped off late; Konsa debut from the bench
Maatsen challenge on Saka with nine minutes gone; penalty downgraded to a free kick because the foul was just outside the area; Odegaard free kick wide
claims.note: AP: nine minutes, Maatsen, VAR downgrade. Al Jazeera: 'because the foul took place just outside the area'; Odegaard free kick just wide.

claims.claim: Villa had no shot on target this season
claims.note: AP: Villa 'without a shot on target so far'.

claims.claim: Villa lost opener 4-0 at Brighton; Jackson and Suzuki Villa debuts

claims.claim: Saka reached 50 England appearances; England won 30 of his first 50; 15 goals in that period; senior debut vs Wales October 2020
50th appearance was England's 4-2 win over Croatia at the World Cup as a second-half substitute; set up Rashford
claims.note: FA page: second-half substitute, assist in the 4-2 win; caption says he set up Rashford.

claims.claim: Aged 24 years and 285 days, fourth England men's player to reach 50 caps before turning 25
Bellingham reached 50 caps less than a week later; The FA covered both in one article
claims.note: FA page is a single article covering both players.

claims.claim: Saka scored an 80th-minute equaliser vs Switzerland that took the match to extra time; England won shootout 5-3; Saka converted his penalty
claims.note: Confirmed on the Premier League page.

claims.claim: Missed a penalty in the EURO 2020 final lost to Italy

claims.note: Fox Sports, published 9 Jan 2026: 'has agreed terms on a new five-year deal'; 'until the summer of 2031'. The sentence now dates the status to the January report.

claims.claim: Previous contract ran until 2027; the January report described the terms as agreed, not as signed
claims.note: Fox Sports: current contract 'runs until 2027'; the report says 'agreed terms', not signed. The article no longer presents this as the present status.

claims.claim: Hip and Achilles problems limited him to 25 Premier League starts; substitute in the 3-0 Costa Rica warm-up in Florida; feeling 'a lot better than I did in March'; prepared to start in Dallas if called upon
claims.note: All quoted on the FA preview page. The link to the title-winning season was not re-checked on this page in this pass.

valueNote: Clear 59th-minute timeline from two outlets, the January contract status stated as the January report, and the England caps milestone from the federation.
summary: All cited facts confirmed on the sources. The contract sentence now states the January 2026 report as it was (agreed, not signed). No unsupported lines remain.
